sub_palette: germanic (norse) backbone + east_asian (sinitic) overlay (cross-family blend, Germanic-leaning)

blend.backbone: germanic (norse / Old Norse register: konungr/jarl, the -son/-dottir patronymics, nominative -r, ai>ei, initial w- lost before round vowels, dithematic -ar/-orm/-ulf names, the river-and-sea far-trader vik-stock)
blend.overlay: east_asian (sinitic: the -cheng silk-cities, the -jiang rivers and -shan mountains, the Confucian -di/-wang/-jun mandarin bureaucracy, monosyllabic surname-first names, the contour-toned isolating substrate)
blend.lean: Germanic-heavy - a Norse far-trading aristocracy (a vik-borne Rus war-merchant house) rowed up the great rivers to Cathay and enthroned itself over the Sinitic silk-empire: the Norse konungr and his jarls hold the Mandate-court at the river-mouth, the Chinese mandarins, the cheng-cities and the silk-and-river populace endure and serve beneath.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_01 Thiodmark (Germanic) x BASE_09 Jinxia (Sinitic/Chinese). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Germanic base = Clanhold, Sinitic (Jinxian/Chinese) base = Civilized, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Seresmark is Civilized (feudal). Concept: a Norse far-trader aristocracy - the Rus reaching Cathay along the great rivers - that rowed its war-keels up the silk-rivers and set itself up as konungr-kings over the Sinitic silk-empire and its Mandate court. Backbone = Germanic (NORSE: the far-trading sea-and-river war-merchant ruling layer, the konungr/jarl register, -son/-dottir patronymics, dithematic name-stock); overlay/substrate = Sinitic (the -cheng silk-cities, the -jiang/-shan land, the Confucian mandarin bureaucracy, the silk-and-river populace, the monosyllabic surname-first names). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Old Norse and Chinese registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Norse reflexes PRIMARY from family_germanic theonym_ancestors norse column; Sinitic variants SECONDARY from family_east_asian theonym_sets.sinitic, in the jinxian -di/-jun register), never real Norse/Chinese gods. PROVISIONAL: alignment (Lawful/Neutral) is a per-hybrid design choice pending the alignment pass - the Norse oath-and-trade war-band meets the Sinitic Mandate-of-Heaven law-court; Lawful reads the just Mandate-throne and the sworn felag, Neutral reads the older Norse ancestral war-dead and the local earth-and-grain powers. Register choice: Germanic-base hybrids default to the GOTHIC/continental reflexes, but Seresmark is the NORSE special case (the Rus/Norse far-traders reaching Cathay) - flag for Jedidiah if a uniform Germanic register is wanted instead. [UPDATE 2026-06-27: all human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic (per-hybrid alignment restriction removed). Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are now English (or an approved foreign term); conlang titles moved to ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. Deities unchanged: canonical Agrippan pantheon via the per-family morph method.]

phonology.palette: Germanic (Norse) backbone - heavy root-initial stress, sharp stops p/t/k b/d/g, retained th/dh, nominative -r, initial w- lost before round vowels (Wod- > Od-), ei/au and ey diphthongs, i- and u-umlaut, dithematic compounding, -son/-dottir patronymics - meeting a Sinitic overlay: monosyllabic morphemes, syllable (C)(G)V(C) with only -n/-ng codas, contour tones (unmarked in data), NO native consonant clusters, surname(1)+given(1-2), the celestial -di/-jun/-wang titles. Per the CSV: tonal contours laid over the Germanic consonant clusters, the Norse stress meeting the Sinitic tone-and-syllable; grammar shifts toward SVO and isolating (the Sinitic substrate) carried on Norse strong-verb stems - 'SVO, isolating strong verbs'. Theophoric on the Norse reflexes (Thulrs-, Orlund-) with Sinitic -di/-jun variants (Tuli-di, Aolan-jun).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC; Norse clusters (st, sk, br, kn, hr, fl) meeting the tight Sinitic monosyllable (no clusters, only -n/-ng codas) - the river-port names fuse a Norse element with a -cheng/-jiang Sinitic head; heavy Norse initial stress laid under the Sinitic tonal contour; dithematic Norse names over surname-first Sinitic mandarin names.

sound_changes: Sinitic tones drop entirely; the bare contour-toned monosyllable is reset to Norse root-initial stress (no tonal contour survives)
Sinitic isolating roots take the Norse nominative/agentive -r and may close on Norse codas (-r, -nr, -ngr), losing the Sinitic only-vowel/-n/-ng restriction: jiang>gjangr, shan>skjarn, cheng>chen-
Sinitic initials with no Norse equal collapse into the Norse inventory and pick up Norse onset-clusters: zh/x/q/j>sk-/sj-/j-, c/z>ts-/s-, h before back vowels>hv- (xi>skir, ze>tser, huang>hvangr)
Sinitic mono-syllables compound to fill Norse dithematic slots, a Sinitic land/material head fused to a Norse element (matou>matou-vik, cheng>chen-borg)
Norse signatures kept throughout: nominative -r, the dh/th dentals, ei/au/ey diphthongs, the st/sk/br/kn/hr clusters; Sinitic leaves its mono-root shapes and its civic/silk vocabulary audible beneath
fusion_rules.source_tilt: river/land/silk/material/civic words from Sinitic roots (the silk-and-river populace works the cheng-cities: jiang, shan, si, yu, tong, cheng); kin-line/quality/abstract/rule/war words from Norse roots (the konungr-aristocracy's register: mikill, svartr, jarn, aett); every root then filtered to one Norse-shaped phonology

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Sinitic river/silk/material/civic roots + Norse kin/quality/rule/war roots, all run through one Norse-shaped sound-law (tones dropped, nominative -r, Norse clusters); portmanteaus mark the blended institutions and bloodline. Norse traders fused to the silk-empire, not a slash-list.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Norse ruling stock keep the -son / -dottir patronymic and an aett (lineage) name; the Sinitic populace keep the clan-surname (xing) first, then the given name (ming), with generation-names within a zu; the throne fuses both - a konungr who carries both a -son patronymic and a granted xing of the Mandate-court.
morphology.compounding_rule: Norse dithematic ([quality|animal|resource](stem) + element: Jarn-borg, iron-fort; Silki-vik, silk-bay) fused to Sinitic quality+type heads (Jin-cheng, golden-city; Da-jiang, great-river): the capital Seres-vik (the silk-trade bay), Jarn-cheng (the iron-walled city), Silki-jiang (the silk-river).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Norse far-trader aristocracy over the Sinitic silk-empire: the konungr and his jarl-kin at the Mandate-throne, the jarls and hersar over the river-cheng, the felag-sworn huskarlar of the war-band; the Sinitic mandarinate - the wang, the five peerages and the Confucian officials - serve beneath and run the cheng-cities and the silk-revenues)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Norse ladder, ascending, with the Sinitic mandarin co-titles beneath. Hersir (war-chieftain, local lord) barony over a Herad (district); Mark-jarl (march-jarl) march over the Mork (border-march); Lendr-madr (the landed king's-man) county over a Len (granted fief); Jarl (earl/great-lord) duchy over a Jarldom; Fylkir (folk-king, host-leader) principality over a Fylki; Konungr (king) kingdom over a Konungriki; Allra-Konungr (the king-of-all, the high-konungr who holds the Mandate-throne) empire over the Stor-riki (the 'great realm'). The conquered silk-empire keeps its Sinitic Wang (king-of-the-old-line, now a vassal-prince) and the five peerages Gong > Hou > Bo > Nan beneath the Norse crown, plus the Dudu frontier-commanders and the Confucian officials who run the cheng-cities. The gothi (Norse priest) and the Sinitic Daoshi stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Old Norse and Chinese registers (allowed).
title_ladder.heir: Konungs-son (the king's son; the heir; the Sinitic court calls him Taizi, the crown-prince)

honorifics.elder: Eldri (the elder) / the Bixia at the Mandate-throne

vassalage.fealty: Eidr (the sworn oath) / Mengyue (Sinitic sworn covenant)

title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Norse ruling stock carry a dithematic given name + -son / -dottir patronymic and an aett lineage; the Sinitic populace carry a monosyllabic surname (xing) first, then the given name (ming); order given-first for the Norse, surname-first for the Sinitic.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Norse war-trader aristocracy keep Old Norse dithematic names (Sig-, Thor-/Thur-, Har-, -ulf, -orm, -arr, -steinn) with -son/-dottir; the Sinitic city-folk and mandarins keep the xing + ming names (Li Zhongyan, Wang Yurong) and the official courtesy-name (zi).
people_name_convention.theophoric: Norse devotional on the morphed canon-reflexes (the Thur-/Thulrs- and Orlund- elements): Thurstein (Thulrs-stone), Orlund-ulf (wolf of Orlund); the Sinitic substrate invokes the celestial powers' epithets rather than the god-name directly - Tian-en (heaven's grace), or a temple-name honoring Tuli-di.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Norse reflexes PRIMARY (family_germanic theonym_ancestors, the norse column), Sinitic variants SECONDARY (family_east_asian theonym_sets.sinitic, rendered in the jinxian -di/-jun celestial register), never real Norse/Chinese gods. The Norse far-traders keep their oath-and-war powers; the conquered silk-empire keeps its Celestial Bureaucracy under the Mandate of Heaven, and the two are quietly identified (one power, two faces). Alignment PROVISIONAL (Lawful/Neutral): the Norse oath-and-trade felag meets the Sinitic Mandate-of-Heaven law-court.
religion.the_one: Eitnir (Norse; Sinitic Aiteng) - the distant Ancient One, the Highest Heaven, honored not petitioned

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Thulr (Sinitic Tuli-di) - the sun and justice, the Sun-Justice Emperor
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Geyandr (Sinitic Gaidun-di) - the enduring earth, lord of mountains
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Rjalta (Sinitic Lianta-mu) - the mother, mercy, the Mother of Mercy

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Eitnir foremost, Thulr the just, Orlund of the sworn war, Rjalta the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers fjandr (foes/devils) or the Sinitic mo (demon-marshals), warded and unworshipped; the felag-oath, the just konungr and the Mandate-throne are the social ideal
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead (the Norse aett-forebears and the deified konungar) and the Sinitic ancestors (the zu) and local earth-and-grain powers; the great powers invoked at the hof and the miao situationally rather than worshipped wholesale
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Eitnir - as the tyrant-gods to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as fjandr (Norse foes) or mo (Sinitic demon-marshals), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Marhr the War-Brand (Sinitic Maluo the War-Fire Marshal); Vacidus -> Vakr the Unmaker (Sinitic Wuci the Devourer); Lusanto -> Lusandr the Hoard-Worm (Sinitic Lusan the Coin-Serpent).
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Hof (Norse temple) or Miao (Sinitic temple) of [power]: 'the Hof of Thulr', 'the Miao of Tuli-di'; the ancestral Ci (Sinitic clan-shrine) for the zu.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified war-dead and konungar of the Norse aett, honored at the haugr (howe) and the hof; and the worthy officials and heroes of the silk-empire enrolled in the celestial register, honored at the Ci (ancestral shrine) and the Miao.

holy_symbol_motifs.Thulr: a sun-disc over a crossed sword and the seal of office
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlund: an iron sword crossed with a war-keel's prow
holy_symbol_motifs.Geyandr: the green mountain over the grain-altar

banks_patterns.ships: river-keels and silk-traders, named in Norse kennings: 'the Silk-Serpent', 'the Wave-Stallion', 'Raven of the Jiang', 'Pride of the Vik'
banks_patterns.military_units: the konungr's hird (war-band) and the felag (the sworn trade-and-war company), plus the Sinitic Ying (camp/army) and the colored Banner: 'the Hird of Seresmark', 'the Silk-felag', 'the Azure Banner of the cheng'
banks_patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Jade Cup', 'The Silk and Salt', 'The Far-Sailed Raven'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: sunken river-borgs and fallen warlord cheng: 'the Borg of [name]', 'the Howe of the Jarls', 'the Ruined Cheng of [warlord]', 'the Drowned Kaupang'

the xing Wang (the old royal line, now vassal-princes)
